description: This file defines a static helper class 'UserHelpers' for creating default user instances during integration tests in the 'Conduit' ASP.NET Core project. It contains methods to facilitate user creation and references external classes and methods related to user creation commands.

classes.name: UserHelpers
classes.description: A static helper class providing functions to create default user data for integration tests.

methods.name: CreateDefaultUser
methods.description: Creates and returns a default user asynchronously for use in integration tests.
